program.name: Single-Leg Strong
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Split squats, single-leg deadlifts and pistol-style progressions for balanced legs.
program.about: Split squats, single-leg deadlifts and pistol-style progressions, for legs that work evenly. Two single-leg days and an upper-body day rotate in straight sets. Level II brings harder variations and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds. Suits you if one side feels weaker, or balance is your next step.
